topics.name: Run Command Family
topics.purpose: Define the recursive `run` command family, including concrete execution/control/status commands such as `run`, `run.go`, `run.status` and cycle semantics where declared.

semantics.namespace_rule: Family/member identities follow the recursive command namespace contract.
semantics.run_rule: Concrete run invocation resolves an exact Routine/runner target and creates or advances explicit execution state according to command semantics.
semantics.go_rule: `run.go` advances/starts the explicitly targeted runner according to its state machine.
semantics.status_rule: `run.status` is read-only projection of exact runner identity/state.
semantics.cycle_rule: Cycle behavior is explicit bounded runner policy, not implicit infinite looping.
semantics.authority_rule: Each concrete command is independently authorized.
semantics.help_rule: Family root may carry master help without becoming executable unless explicitly declared.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions and runner executions are separate canonical identities; runners execute explicit ordered routine content through the normal governed dispatch boundary.

hard_gates.condition: cycle defaults to unbounded infinite loop
subcommand authority inherited implicitly without policy
runner target inferred by last-used hidden state

references.purpose: Commands act on explicit runner identities.
